description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/sanctions/screen (base $0.01; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?name=Example Name (optional country, dob, type=individual|entity|vessel|aircraft). No match is not a clearance.. Screen one name against the OFAC SDN list and the OFAC Consolidated list. Optional country, date of birth and type. Matches include a score, list name, entry id, programs and the list publish date. No match is not a clearance. Bad input or a list that did not load: not charged. USDC on Base only.
name: sanctions_screen_quote
title: OFAC Name Screen Payment Quote
